correctness.rationale: For the exact 18 labeled associative ternary multiplication tables, the finite rightward dependency cone makes all initial length-n words realizable. Group rules yield 3^n or 3*2^(n-1); trigger and stabilization languages give the nine listed formula types, including the exceptional n=1 rule 3 and rule 10 one-symbol transient; semilattice rule 13 gives binomial(n+2,2). Each description constructs and excludes all words for all n, not merely experimental n. Independent enumeration verified table associativity and all 144 rule-length cases for n=1..8, corroborating but not replacing the infinite normal-form proof.
